title: The Second Voyage of Master Martin Frobisher, in Voyages in Search of the North-West Passage
version: 1577 voyage account, in Henry Morley’s 1892 Cassell edition; Project Gutenberg full-text transcription
lineage: Full public-domain transcription of the 1892 edition inspected; Settle’s account concerns the 1577 voyage, not an inspected 16th-century edition. The small boat is not explicitly called decked.

passages.note: Second voyage, 1577, description of the country and people: two sizes with leather on wood frames, the smaller for one person to sit and row.
